column3: NKJV includes “who do not walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends at “in Christ Jesus.”
NKJV has “made me free,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “made you free.”
NKJV has “through His Spirit who dwells in you,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “because of His Spirit.”
NKJV has “weaknesses” and “for us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “weakness” and lacks “for us.”
